evals.prompt: Estructura la feature de facturación (billing) en mi app Next.js con Screaming Architecture, archivos iniciales y su página en el App Router.
evals.expected_output: The agent runs scaffold-feature.mjs billing --with-starter --with-route (first with --dry-run). It creates src/features/billing/ with components, hooks, models, schemas, screens, services and utils, a flat model models/billing.ts with its barrel, the encapsulated screen screens/billing-home/ with a Vitest test and an index.ts, and the thin page src/app/billing/page.tsx. It does not create an index.ts at the feature root or in components/. The reply is in Spanish.

evals.prompt: Create a modal dialog to create invoices inside the billing feature.
evals.expected_output: The agent uses scaffold-component.mjs invoice-form-dialog --target-dir src/features/billing/components --type dialog. It generates the 'use client' component based on FormDialog with TSDoc, its adjacent Vitest test (vi.fn()) and an index.ts in the leaf folder.

evals.prompt: Review these imports: `import { usePetSearch, IPet } from '@/features/pets';`, `import { InvoiceCard } from '@/features/pets/components';` and `import { parsePetFilters } from '@/features/pets/utils/parse-pet-filters';`
evals.expected_output: The agent points out that the first two import from container folders without a barrel and the third skips the barrel of the utils/ leaf folder. It rewrites them to point to the leaf folders with an index.ts: '@/features/pets/hooks/use-pet-search', '@/features/pets/models', '@/features/pets/components/invoice-card' and '@/features/pets/utils'. It says to delete any index.ts in container folders.

evals.prompt: Implementa una Server Action para crear facturas en la feature billing junto con su esquema de validación y su hook para usarla desde un formulario.
evals.expected_output: The agent defines the flat schema in src/features/billing/schemas/create-invoice.schema.ts and re-exports it in schemas/index.ts (no test). It creates the encapsulated service in src/features/billing/services/create-invoice/create-invoice.service.ts with 'use server', validating with createInvoiceSchema.safeParse(input) on the server before calling fetch/DB and running revalidatePath, along with create-invoice.service.test.ts (Vitest) and index.ts. It creates the hook in src/features/billing/hooks/use-create-invoice/ with useTransition, its test and index.ts, using '@/features/billing/...' alias imports. The reply is in Spanish.

evals.prompt: Set up the testing and linting environment for our Next.js app following the project architecture.
evals.expected_output: The agent configures Vitest with @vitejs/plugin-react-swc, the jsdom environment and @vitest/coverage-v8 with thresholds >= 90% and explicit exclusions for src/app/**, src/config/**, **/models/**, **/schemas/** and **/index.ts. It configures Playwright in e2e/<feature>.spec.ts to test the thin routes in src/app/**, and OXC (.oxlintrc.json) with the typescript, react, nextjs, jsx-a11y, import and vitest plugins.
